contexts.text: The edge of a curtain in the extremity in the joining () = where one ceases and the other begins, thus the borders where the two conjoin themselves together. AC 9607.
The edge of the curtain where the loops were = the sphere of truth, where it ceases.

The edge of the breast-plate which is on this side the ephod inwards () = conjunction with the middle part of Heaven, and thus preservation... The edge which is on this side the ephod = the middle part.
I looked towards the sea-coast in the Spiritual World...
